audit.source_mutation_policy: All JSONL source handles rb only; final SHA-256 and size/mtime compared against streaming scan. Writes confined to report directory.
audit.exact_coverage: Every nonblank physical line of every discovered JSONL, strict UTF-8 and strict JSON. Duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers rejected. Complete extracted-document SHA-256 and case-sensitive whitespace-normalized hashes, within and across datasets. No casefold, Unicode normalization, translation or identifier renaming in exact dedup.
audit.privacy_limitations: Regex candidate scan of every extracted text. Pattern matches are not confirmed secrets/PII; arbitrary names, addresses, confidential data, obfuscated credentials and unrecognized token formats may be missed. Stored examples omit matched values. No remote credential validation.
audit.content_limitations: Full streaming heuristics plus reproducibly sampled manual review. Quality proxies are not deletion decisions. No code execution; Python3 AST syntax only. Other languages not compiled. No semantic proof or complete fact verification.
audit.near_status: completed sampled anchor search against full corpus index
audit.length_quantile_definition: sorted decoded-character lengths at floor((n-1)*q); lower order statistic, no interpolation

cpp_extract_check.consequence: CRLF source sequences become CRCRLF; missing terminal newlines permit joined document boundaries. Source JSONL text itself remains unchanged.

near_duplicates.method: 64 deterministic minhash-like salted uint64 minima over case-sensitive lexical 5-token shingles; 16 bands x 4; >=10 lexical tokens; feature cap 8192 for signatures; >=0.65 signature equality shortlist; exact full-shingle Jaccard >=0.80 verification. Full-corpus hash index with seeded uniform per-file anchor samples. Normalized exact matches excluded.
near_duplicates.limitations: Detector recall is uncalibrated; intervals describe detector-positive anchor rate, not a proven corpus near-duplicate rate. No near search on <10 lexical token anchors. Caps and skipped buckets are recorded; partial/translated/renamed-code matches may be missed. No claim of exhaustive pairwise near scan.

repeated_blocks.method: Full corpus: split on blank-line boundaries, collapse whitespace, hash blocks >=120 normalized characters. Counts occurrences, including repeated blocks inside a record; may include licenses and legitimate shared declarations. Not a semantic duplicate count.

manual_review.review_type: Qualitative review of redacted excerpts; not all full documents and not a factual-error prevalence estimate.
manual_review.seed_and_sampling: Algorithm R; reservoir 22 per curated file with seed 20261023; 8 per code file and 20 FineWeb with seed 4401; all 2 generator examples. Earlier 4-record peeks and targeted issue examples additional, not counted.
manual_review.technical_accuracy: 1,863 narrowly recognized QA answers checked deterministically (see per-file results); selected Gren String and Dict APIs checked against core 7.0.0 official documentation; a FineWeb history contradiction confirmed against British Museum content. Other claims not exhaustively verified. No dataset code executed.
